correctness.rationale: With w=0^a 1 0^b 1 0^c 1 0^d, exact disjoint factor-boundary enumeration gives P3=t^(b+c+3)S_a S_d and P2=t^(b+2)S_a S_c+t^(c+2)S_b S_d. min degree and max degree of P3 recover b+c and total word length; the coefficient staircase of normalized P3 recovers unordered outer gaps {a,d}, and min degree of P2 recovers min(b,c), hence unordered interior gaps {b,c}. At most two reversal-orbits remain; comparing them gives nonzero Δ=(S_a-S_d)t²(t^b-t^c)/(1-t) if a≠d and b≠c. Thus all boundary cases including zero gaps are covered. Independent exhaustive direct substring counts for all words with exactly three ones of lengths 3..16 confirm no non-reversal collisions, but arbitrary length is proved by the polynomial argument. Four-one collision pair 01001101 and 01101001 is prior art and can be independently checked.

value.rationale: Recovering the full sequence from only two filtered heavy composition layers is a natural sharp sparse-marker information threshold. The finding separates the minimal sufficient high-weight factor data from full composition spectra, and the four-marker obstruction proves a meaningful precise boundary. It is useful for string reconstruction with partial observations, not an arbitrary binary-word census.
